text: Marketing and sales expense for fiscal 2025 was $48.2M, up 12% year over year, driven primarily by field and events programs. Management expects to hold events spend roughly flat in fiscal 2026 pending pipeline performance.
Master services agreement with Vertex Events Co. commits Acme to a minimum annual spend of $1.2M through Q4 2026. Early termination triggers a 30% cancellation fee on the remaining commitment.
Budget reallocation policy: any single line-item cut exceeding $500K within a quarter requires CFO sign-off and a documented pipeline-impact assessment.
